Package dev.gmitch215.bytebox.html

Interface TextChunk

All Superinterfaces:
org.teavm.jso.JSObject
public interface TextChunk extends org.teavm.jso.JSObject
A piece of text. The parser does not buffer, so one text node can arrive as several chunks; the last has isLastInTextNode() set and may be empty.
Since:
1.0.3
